features.title: Add --clean flag to remove local build artifacts and state
acceptance: ai-factory --clean removes repos directory, state.json, and pushed.log
Command reports what was removed or already clean
No syntax warnings when running CLI

features.title: Fix SyntaxWarning invalid escape sequences in appdefs_batch3.py
acceptance: No SyntaxWarning on import of appdefs_batch3
All triple-quoted code templates are raw strings
implementation: appdefs_batch3.py: first two triple-quoted strings now raw (r''')

features.title: Add --version flag to show version from VERSION file
acceptance: Version read from VERSION file at project root
Flag exits early without loading apps or logging
implementation: factory.py:main handles --version before any other logic

features.title: Keep virtualenvs, databases, and dependency trees out of the publish index
acceptance: .gitignore excludes .venv, node_modules, dist, bytecode, env files, databases, egg-info, and local agent metadata
git check-ignore matches those paths and still tracks .env.example
The git index does not list .venv or ai_factory.egg-info

features.title: Browser console for catalog, dry-run, and build history
acceptance: Operator can list templates, dry-run one app, and read build history from the API and UI
Docker build uses only files inside the backend context
Clean and cycle actions do not touch the operator home directory or GitHub unless explicitly configured
Login is unimplemented until a later milestone
